newsitem.title: USA: Ford Motor Co to discontinue Aspire.
newsitem.headline: Ford Motor Co to discontinue Aspire.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Tuesday it would discontinue its Aspire model subcompact car after the 1997 model year.
Ford said discontinuing the Aspire would allow dealers to focus on selling the subcompact Ford Escort.
Ford said it has sold about 133,000 Aspires since introducing it as three- and five-door subcompact models in February 1994.
But sales fell to 37,359 units in 1996, down from 59,191 in 1995 and that trend continued in January, with 1,859 units sold, down 46.9 percent a year ago.
The Aspire is made for Ford by Kia Motors Corp, of which Ford owns 10 percent.
